# 📦 Release Notes

> ⚠️ **Flash at your own risk**

> ⚠️ Only **Android 16** ROMs

---

## Features
- **KernelSU Next** v3.2.0
- **SUSFS** v2.2.0
- **BORE** Scheduler
- **BBR** Congestion algorithm
- **FQ** Fair Queue Scheduling
- **300Hz** Kernel timer interrupt frequency
- **LZO** Compression algorithm
---

## 📝 Flashing instructions
* Backup **vendor_boot.img**, **vendor_dlkm.img**, and **boot.img** before flashing
* Flash the AK3 zip file with a kernel flasher app or in recovery with ``adb sideload [kernel.zip]``

---
